_readme: What the extension process must actually SEE, as opposed to what a schema claims.
A schema diff proves the JSON matches. It does not prove the binding was
generated, the API feature resolved, or the permission registered -- which is
exactly how chrome.scripting came to be compiled in, schema and all, and
undefined in every extension. OrbitAppTests/ChromiumExtensionRuntimeSurfaceReflectionLiveTests
loads a real MV3 fixture declaring every permission Orbit supports, walks the
`chrome` object inside its own service worker, and checks the report against
this file and against Orbit's own schemas.
mustBeDefined: namespaces an extension holding these permissions must be able
to reach. A missing one is the chrome.scripting failure recurring.
knownUnavailable: namespaces Orbit compiles and that still do not resolve at
runtime, each with the reason. Asserted UNDEFINED, so the day one starts
working this test fails and the entry has to be deleted -- the same
two-directional discipline as ExpectedAPIGaps.json.
permissionGatedNamespaces: the negative control. With none of these
permissions declared, each namespace must be undefined. Orbit already had
one of these for webNavigation as a one-off; this is the table version.
OrbitTests/ExtensionRuntimeSurfaceExpectationsTests asserts every
permission: dependency in Chromium/Embedder/common/api/_api_features.json
has a row here, so a newly-gated namespace cannot skip the control.

knownUnavailable.userScripts: No delegated availability check, so the feature never resolves for an ordinary extension even though //extensions compiles the whole API (section 0).
knownUnavailable.contextMenus: Chrome-layer and not ported; the second-most-used extension surface after the toolbar button.
knownUnavailable.commands: The manifest key parses and nothing consumes it, so no keyboard shortcut, including _execute_action, ever fires.
knownUnavailable.identity: Chrome-layer and not ported; blocks every OAuth-backed extension.
knownUnavailable.sidePanel: Chrome-layer and not ported; the modern MV3 primary UI surface.
knownUnavailable.extension: The legacy chrome.extension namespace is still called by a large amount of shipped MV3 code.
knownUnavailable.tabGroups: Chrome-layer and not ported; pairs with the missing tabs.group/ungroup.
knownUnavailable.contentSettings: The implementation is already compiled in extensions/browser/api/content_settings; only the chrome-layer schema and feature entry are missing.
knownUnavailable.declarativeContent: Chrome-layer and not ported; the MV3-sanctioned conditional page action.
knownUnavailable.downloads: Orbit has a native download stack and no extension API over it.
knownUnavailable.debugger: Chrome-layer and not ported; with devtools.* this is every DevTools extension.
knownUnavailable.devtools: Chrome-layer and not ported: inspectedWindow, network and panels together, so React/Vue/Redux DevTools cannot load.

management.note: Unlike the fully-gated namespaces, chrome.management is defined without its permission but keeps only its three dependencies:[] members. That partial shape is what made the missing name-to-id registration invisible for so long, so the control asserts the shape rather than absence.
